2608.04766.title: FUSEP: A Multi-Center Benchmark for Diverse Tasks in Early Pregnancy Fetal Ultrasound Screening
2608.04766.paper_summary: A large number of infants with congenital anomalies are born each year globally, especially in areas with underdeveloped medical resources. Currently, fetal ultrasound screening is the most common modality for early pregnancy anatomy detection. This modality can detect anomalies earlier and provide opportune treatment advice. However, the lack of an ultrasound dataset on early fetal gestation has slowed down the development of automated assisted diagnosis. In this work, we present a benchmark dataset for Fetal Ultrasound Screening in Early Pregnancy to facilitate intelligent ultrasound examination and assisted diagnosis called FUSEP. Our dataset consists of two ultrasound views recommended by the international guideline, i.e., Crown-rump Length (CRL) and Nuchal Translucency (NT) views in three hospitals, totaling 4,017 ultrasound images, with 45,820 box-level expert-level annotations. Our dataset and baseline present the following three contributions: 1) Our medical experts annotated a total of 14 key anatomical structures in two views using a box-level format; 2) Our data is collected extensively from different sonographers, devices, scanning angles, hospitals, etc; 3) We report the performance of the semi-supervised learning, fully supervised learning, unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA), and source-free UDA in ultrasound images multi-object detection. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first publicly available dataset and benchmark for fetal early pregnancy ultrasound screening. We believe that FUSEP and benchmark can contribute to the medical community in the development of multiple tasks such as standard plane recognition, quality control on ultrasound images, automated assisted diagnostics in early fetal pregnancy, medical multi-object detection, domain adaptation for object detection, etc.
2608.04766.paper_summary_zh: 每年全球有大量先天性畸形的嬰兒出生，特別是在醫療資源不發達的地區。<lb/>目前，胎兒超聲篩查是早期懷孕解剖檢測最常用的方式。<lb/>這種方式可以更早地檢測到異常並提供及時的治療建議。<lb/>然而，缺乏早期胎兒妊娠的超聲數據集已經減緩了自動輔助診斷的發展。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們提出了一個名為FUSEP的早期懷孕胎兒超聲篩查基準數據集，以促進智能超聲檢查和輔助診斷。<lb/>我們的數據集由國際指南推薦的兩個超聲視圖組成，即冠臀長度（CRL）和頸部透明帶（NT）視圖，來自三家醫院，總共包含4,017張超聲圖像，並有45,820個框級專家級註釋。<lb/>我們的數據集和基準提供了以下三個貢獻：1）我們的醫療專家使用框級格式註釋了兩個視圖中的14個關鍵解剖結構；2）我們的數據廣泛收集自不同的超聲醫生、設備、掃描角度、醫院等；3）我們報告了在超聲圖像多物體檢測中半監督學習、全監督學習、無監督領域適應（UDA）和無源UDA的性能。<lb/>據我們所知，這是第一個公開可用的胎兒早期懷孕超聲篩查數據集和基準。我們相信FUSEP和基準可以促進醫學界在多個任務的發展，如標準平面識別、超聲圖像質量控制、早期胎兒懷孕的自動輔助診斷、醫學多物體檢測、物體檢測的領域適應等。
